title: trollius europaeus subsp. transsilvanicus
intro: Trollius europaeus subsp. transsilvanicus, commonly known as Eastern globeflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Trollius europaeus subsp. transsilvanicus include its potential in treating digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its ability to act as a diuretic and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
